title: Dell reports Q1 AI server revenue up 757% YoY to $16.1B and raises its FY 2027 AI server revenue forecast to $60B, up from its prior projection of $50B (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Mike Wheatley / SiliconANGLE: Dell reports Q1 AI server revenue up 757% YoY to $16.1B and raises its FY 2027 AI server revenue forecast to $60B, up from its prior projection of $50B — Dell Technologies Inc. delivered its fastest rate of revenue growth since returning to the public markets more than seven years ago …
